title: the soundness gate battery — five forcing functions, landed FIRST
summary: The five chronics that the whole AX tranche exists to kill are now IMPOSSIBLE rather than NOTED. Each gate is born-RED on its inverse and self-proves its bite where applicable.

commit-hook-mechanism.decision: native .githooks/ + git config core.hooksPath (dependency-free; NO husky added), wired by scripts/install-hooks.mjs from `prepare`. BOTH arms: the local .githooks/commit-msg fast bite AND the ci-tagged proof:live-verified-ledger job (so a --no-verify bypass is still caught on CI).
commit-hook-mechanism.rationale: the repo carries no husky/lint-staged; adding a hook framework for one hook is over-engineering. A tracked .githooks dir + hooksPath is the KISS gestalt and survives a fresh clone via prepare.

emit-ci-dangling-policy.decision: RED-naming — renderCiYaml() THROWS naming any ci-tagged gate whose backing scripts/*.mjs is absent (never a silent skip). PLUS resolved the two phantom danglers NOW (the user requires perfected CI and a RED-blocking emit would otherwise stall): proof:styling-hygiene (its subject — the BouncyToggle pill-track trim — died with BouncyToggle at W53) and proof:glass-card-tiers (never-built) are RETIRED from the manifest + package.json + the KNOWN_DANGLING baseline (now empty).
emit-ci-dangling-policy.rationale: RED-naming is the forcing function for future waves; retiring the two extant phantoms is the honest discharge (a never-built script whose subject was deleted is dead weight, not coverage). A fresh styling/tier invariant is W25/W27a's to author against the CURRENT surface.

gates.bornRed: a PROGRESS status cell of `live-verified` with no on-disk .png DELTA, or a retired `(DEVELOPED)` modifier, is unflagged
gates.green: self-test flags a synthetic DELTA-less live-verified row every run; 67 wave rows parsed, 0 live-verified, 0 (DEVELOPED) in any status cell. Commit-msg hook armed.

gates.bornRed: tests/ was in NO tsconfig scope since AV.W14; a dead test import was type-invisible
gates.green: `vue-tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` folded into the typecheck script; the tests/ mirror type-checks GREEN after 6 real fixes the fold surfaced (incl. the AuroraHarmony dead import — the fold's first real catch, a TS2305). shims.d.ts types the .mjs gate imports; noImplicitAny relaxed for test-scope ergonomics.
gates.biteProof: the AuroraHarmony TS2305 the fold caught at authoring
realFixes: tests/components/custom/aurora/atoms.test.ts — AuroraHarmony re-pointed from constants/presets (dead) to composables/color
tests/composables.smoke.spec.ts — SidebarSection fixture given the required `title` (non-field `label` removed)
tests/configurator-recursion.spec.ts — process listener cast to NodeJS.{Unhandled,Uncaught}* listener shapes

gates.bornRed: 12 stale imports across 4 sibling repos (fourier ×4, words ×2, bbnf-buddy ×1, speedtest ×5) import the W53-deleted Bouncy*/UnderlineTabs family + the retired /responsive-tabs subpath
gates.green: every present-consumer glass-ui import resolves against the current surface. DISCHARGED by the W34/Batch-7 consumer migration; absent siblings skip (CI-green). The named arm follows the dist d.ts export* chain recursively (incl. `export type {}` re-exports) — zero false positives after the parser hardening.
gates.biteProof: 12 real cross-repo stale imports flagged at HEAD; sibling-absent → skip
gates.note: DELETION_SWEEP_ROOTS = [src, demo, tests] minted in constellation.mjs; proof:tabs-unified now consumes it (the tests/ blind spot is closed for every deletion gate).

gates.bornRed: ci.yml had DRIFTED 20 ci-tagged gates behind the manifest (W23/W24/W45/W52/W53 + the constellation band never mirrored) — CI was effectively RED on the missing set
gates.green: ci.yml is now a GENERATED artefact (gates.mjs --emit-ci, 92 ci gates + 2 meta-steps); proof:gen-ci-fresh asserts byte-identity (drift impossible, not merely detected); both gates added to the RELEASE set so a drifted ci.yml refuses to publish. gates.mjs CLI guarded run-as-main so renderCiYaml is importable.
gates.biteProof: a hand-edit or an un-re-emitted ci gate reds the byte-match

gates.bornRed: no gate re-evaluated a deferral's named trigger; a met trigger could ride BOOK'd forever (native-drawer LATE-1, the AN ARCHIVED items LATE-3)
gates.green: DISPOSITION-REGISTER.json seeds the 3 named book/archived rows; the gate re-evaluates each min-consumers trigger against the present constellation (all 3 un-MET → green). Self-test (a synthetic always-MET book row) proves the detector bites every run.
gates.biteProof: self-test (synthetic met-trigger row) on every invocation
